header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH,
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
body: None present on behalf of the petitioner nor any intimation is received. This petition was filed in the year 2023 and lastly fixed on 21.11.2023, on that date no one was present on behalf of the petitioner. Since then, no efforts were made by the counsel for the petitioner to get the matter fixed to proceed with it. It appears that counsel for the petitioner has lost interest in the matter. Accordingly, this petition is dismissed for non-prosecution.
